//: Who may call what. src/main/roles.js is the only reader of the policy; the renderer gets viewer.allowed, capabilities, nav, modes and hiddenPages in state and may import this file for labels and copy only. Every method in studio-api-channels.json sits in exactly one capability (test/roles.test.js); a method in none is admin-only. A composite method's capability is the same as, or requires, the capability of everything it can run. Admins hold every capability; editor- and channel-based roles hold what their role grants, adjusted per person (deny wins). lock 'admin' capabilities can never be granted; lock 'always' is held by everyone with a role. A channel-based role can only ever call channelSafeMethods. An editor-based role holding a spends capability also needs seeCosts, and a role without seeCosts never receives money fields.

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Everything, including settings, people and analytics.

roles.label: Editor
roles.description: Finds trends, writes and edits reports, makes assets for any channel.

roles.label: Channel owner
roles.description: Sees new trends and their channel’s assets, and says which trends they used.

capabilities.label: Open the studio
capabilities.description: Sign in, see the studio and choose their own layout.

capabilities.label: See research and evidence
capabilities.description: Research runs, trends, the trend tracker and the posts behind them.

capabilities.label: Start research
capabilities.description: Run research programs and continue paused runs, after seeing the cost.

capabilities.label: Run quick scans
capabilities.description: Small, recent scans planned with Ask AI, after seeing the cost.

capabilities.label: Approve trends
capabilities.description: Say Yes or Skip to new trends.

capabilities.label: Read reports and assets
capabilities.description: Open trends reports, editorial toolkits and channel assets, and read the notes on them.

capabilities.label: Write reports
capabilities.description: Write trends reports, and content from a report, a Google Doc or pasted text.

capabilities.label: Edit reports
capabilities.description: Edit and restore reports (together, in the browser studio), move assets through review, and save research reviews.

capabilities.label: Leave notes on reports
capabilities.description: Add notes to reports and assets, reply, mention teammates, and resolve notes. Channel owners leave notes on their own channel’s briefs and assets.

capabilities.label: Make channel assets
capabilities.description: Make channel assets from a report. Channel owners make them for their own channel.

capabilities.label: Stop and retry work
capabilities.description: Stop work that is running, and finish what is left.

capabilities.label: Mark trends used
capabilities.description: Say whether a channel is using a trend, with its link and planned date.

capabilities.label: Use Ask AI
capabilities.description: Ask about the studio and its research, keep conversations and memory, and make pictures.

capabilities.label: See AI prompts
capabilities.description: Read every prompt behind research, reports and assets, and preview them for free.

capabilities.label: Edit AI prompts
capabilities.description: Change the editable parts of a prompt, restore older versions and run paid tests.

capabilities.label: See workflows and playbooks
capabilities.description: Saved automations, their runs and what they cost, and the playbooks that set them up.

capabilities.label: Build and run workflows
capabilities.description: Save workflows, run them after seeing the cost, pause, stop and retry them.

capabilities.label: Use Sheets
capabilities.description: Open, import, edit and export workbooks, including the trend tracker.

capabilities.label: Use data tools
capabilities.description: Scrapers, datasets, dataset reports and brief starters.

capabilities.label: Delete scrapers
capabilities.description: Remove saved scrapers for good.

capabilities.label: Export and publish
capabilities.description: Publish reports to Google Docs, export runs and reviews, and sync the trend board to Monday.

capabilities.label: See costs and budgets
capabilities.description: Costs, budgets and estimates. Anyone who can start paid work has this too.

capabilities.label: Manage research programs
capabilities.description: Create and edit research programs, with their sources, budgets and schedules; set up playbooks and approve what workflows may spend.

capabilities.label: Edit brand knowledge
capabilities.description: Voice, rules, reference documents, brand images and the product list.

capabilities.label: Switch workspaces
capabilities.description: Switch or create workspaces. Switching moves everyone using the studio.

capabilities.label: See team analytics
capabilities.description: Which channels used which trends, and the team’s recent activity.

capabilities.label: Settings and connections
capabilities.description: Keys, AI routes, connections, setup files and prompt locks.

capabilities.label: People and access
capabilities.description: Invite people, change roles and what each role can do, preview access and read the access log.

//paidMethods: Methods that spend outside a capability that spends (paid Settings checks and AI job tests): a server draining for a restart refuses them (studio-server.js DRAIN_REFUSED).
//pages: Each page and the capability that shows it, in this order for hiddenPages. Simple and Advanced share one namespace; the Advanced data-tools pages hide as one group (pageGroups), so a role without data tools keeps Simple Reports. channelPages are the channel owner's shell.

roleTemplates.label: Viewer
roleTemplates.description: Reads reports, trends and evidence. Sees no costs and changes nothing.

roleTemplates.label: Analyst
roleTemplates.description: Researches with quick scans, Ask AI, Sheets and data tools, and sees what they cost.

roleTemplates.label: Channel reviewer
roleTemplates.description: Reads their channel’s trends and assets, and says which trends they used.
